subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft/checklist while sending the final assistant answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a compact summary, and the requested full-draft/checklist behavior adds a new public config and lifecycle policy rather than fixing broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned finalization option that keeps the completed progress draft while preserving the current collapse-summary behavior by default.

options.title: Keep collapse summary only
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation and keep the current final answer plus compact activity digest lifecycle.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track the need as a broader cross-channel progress-card API before adding a Telegram-specific finalization flag.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned finalization option that keeps the completed progress draft while preserving the current collapse-summary behavior by default.

likelyOwner.reason: Most current code and recent merged history for the affected Telegram progress summary/finalization path points to vincentkoc.
